seal.statement: A passing durable proof receipt (scripts/proof-authority.js recordProof) can only be recorded from a validated execution report of the exact candidate. The runner owns one report schema (candidate sha and release proof identity, producer, commands with exit statuses, planned vs executed vs skipped files, per-file results with assertion counts, retry record). recordProof refuses with typed problem codes an absent or partial report, a sha or identity mismatch, a failed or skipped planned file, a zero-assertion pass, a truncated corpus, a failed command, and a passed-on-retry file unless the sealed policy for that proof id admits qualified results, in which case the receipt carries the qualification and is never a clean pass. Existing lawful reuse (resolveProof, identity-catalogued proofs, append-only receipt history) is unchanged and old receipts are not reinterpreted.
